entry.name: Meteor Market
entry.description: Slide your basket through identical meteor showers, catch valuable crystals, dodge cargo-jamming mines, and outscore your friends in 35-second shifts.

scenarios: Shared crystals resolve independently; mines floor cargo and jam movement
Ready phase, input validation, basket bounds, and exact catch edge
Timeout awards once, ties play on, and next round resets only shift state
Disconnected and empty stalls cannot earn round awards
Eight-player full replay has bounded complete snapshots and no lingering drops
